name: luckyclover
description: LuckyClover — white-label lottery management platform (portfolio prototype). Bettor web app, reseller POS, and admin panel over a mocked Supabase backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n cliente,revendedor,admin -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:cliente" "npm run dev:revendedor" "npm run dev:administrador"
scripts.build: npm run build:cliente && npm run build:revendedor && npm run build:administrador
